faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q_payment: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a_payment: Through ECPay we accept credit cards (instalments available), ATM transfer to a virtual account, and convenience store payment codes. ATM and store codes are issued after you place the order — please pay before the deadline, as unpaid orders are cancelled automatically and the stock released.
faq.q_modify: Can I change my order after placing it?
faq.a_modify: Orders cannot be edited once placed. If it hasn't shipped yet, email {email} during support hours with your order number and we'll help.
faq.q_coupon: How do I use a coupon code?
faq.a_coupon: Enter it in the “Coupon code” field on the cart page and press Apply — the discount is reflected in the total straight away. Each code has its own minimum spend and usage limit, and only one code can be used per order.
faq.a_fee: Convenience store pickup is {cvs} and home delivery is {home}. Orders over {threshold} ship free.
faq.a_dispatch: Within 1–3 business days of payment clearing (holidays push this back). We email you when it ships, and you can follow the delivery under My Account → Orders.
faq.q_cvs: Which convenience stores can I collect from?
faq.a_cvs: 7-ELEVEN, FamilyMart, Hi-Life and OK Mart. Choose store pickup at checkout and ECPay's store map opens so you can pick a branch. You'll get an SMS when the parcel arrives — please collect it within 7 days.
faq.a_invoice: Invoices are issued on paper and shipped with your parcel; if you need a company tax ID (three-copy invoice), enter it at checkout. Once payment completes we also email an electronic receipt — note this receipt is not a uniform invoice and cannot be used for tax filing.
faq.q_returns: Can I return or exchange an item?
faq.a_returns: Under Taiwan's Consumer Protection Act you have a 7-day inspection period from delivery (an inspection period, not a trial period). Returned items must be unused and complete, with original packaging and tags. For hygiene reasons, intimate apparel cannot be returned or exchanged once opened or tried on.
faq.a_refund: 3–7 business days after we receive the return and confirm its condition. Credit card reversals follow your issuing bank's schedule, usually 1–2 billing cycles.
